text.description_html:
Acorn WNABP, Warwick Rough Iron Push Plate

This 12" push plate is forged in black iron. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the natural weathering of iron. It's made by Acorn, which means the WNAPB Push Plate will last for many years of use and add old world charm to your home. Its decorative style is great indoors or outdoors. The Warwick Rough Iron Push Plate is surface mounted and is easily installed with just a few screws.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications for the 12 inch Warwick Rough Iron Push Plate:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 12"
  • Width: 2-1/2"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 push plate and hardware for a surfaced mounting application. This door push plate is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
